**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

I do not go on the principle of no love at all, and letting nobody marry, but I do not think it will do to have it the whole subject and interest of the story.[^2]

[^1]: This fragment is quoted by Enid Huws Jones, Mrs Humphry Ward (London : Heinemann, 1973), who states that the MS was then owned by Georgina Battiscombe.

[^2]: The letter is described as a rejection of a story called ‘A Gay Life’ as unsuitable for [MP](../others.html#52).,
